name: AutoGen (Microsoft)
shortDescription: Microsoft open-source Python library for multi-agent conversations. The newest recorded release is from 2025.
longDescription: AutoGen is Microsoft's open-source Python library and framework for multi-agent conversations. You can have several agents work through a task together, and there is no product paywall.
pricingNotes: No SaaS pricing page for the framework. Latest GitHub python release python-v0.7.5 dated 2025-09-30 — older than peers; industry notes mention Microsoft Agent Framework as successor — flag for catalog freshness.
bestFor: Teams that want an open-source library with no product paywall
notIdealFor: Anyone who needs a release newer than September 30, 2025
strength: AutoGen 0.7.5 is open source with no product paywall.
weakness: The newest Python release on record is dated September 30, 2025.

handsOn.detail: We installed version 0.7.5 and confirmed it loads. We did not sign up, pay, or run it on a real task.

useCaseFit.multi-agent-workflows: Open-source Python library for conversations between more than one agent.
